_comment: Prismheart waystones (PRISM02, contest G10, disk-saver). Each stands one step off the road from a world-map landmark; tools/rpg_demo/waystones.py places it on the first walkable tile, reachable on foot from the Town, next to that landmark's exit. 'bit' is the waystone's permanent slot in the WAY1 save string: never reuse or renumber a bit, append new waystones with new bits.

waystones.name: Hearthgate Stone
waystones.lore: Set by the first lamplighters so no traveller sleeps outside the walls.

waystones.name: Windmere Lodestone
waystones.lore: Hums in the same key as the pond's koi when the wind is right.

waystones.name: Cinderstep Stone
waystones.lore: Warm to the touch; the Pyre Warden's smoke still clings to it.

waystones.name: Aerie Lodestone
waystones.lore: Feathers gather at its foot and never blow away.

waystones.name: Sunwell Lodestone
waystones.lore: Glows faintly at noon, remembering the Sanctum's light.
